proposed.text: What minimum educational qualification is required for a CSG inspector under SPP 204-A?

options.text: A technical vocational diploma in construction
A Bachelor of Science in Architecture (BS Arch) degree
A master's degree in construction management
Any engineering degree from a CHED-recognized school

rationale.a: A vocational diploma is insufficient. SPP 204-A requires a professional degree.
rationale.b: Correct. A CSG inspector must hold a Bachelor of Science in Architecture (BS Arch) degree, ensuring professional competence in architectural supervision.
rationale.c: A master's degree is not required. The minimum is a BS Arch degree.
rationale.d: An engineering degree does not substitute for the BS Arch requirement for CSG inspectors under SPP 204-A.
rationale.correct: SPP 204-A requires CSG inspectors to hold a BS Architecture degree as a minimum qualification. This ensures inspectors have the architectural knowledge needed to verify that construction faithfully executes the architect's design intent.
rationale.takeaway: CSG inspector minimum qualification = BS Arch degree.
